title: Magnus vs. Martin with 8 QUEENS
summary: Magnus bot (2882, White) vs Martin bot (250, Black) where Martin's eight pawns are replaced by queens (8 extra queens). He relays each bot's moves between two games. The start is already zugzwang/lost for White (Qxf2# threat), Magnus plays Nh3 and other engine-precise 'longest survival' moves while Martin randomly develops queens, ignores threats and leaves queens hanging; Magnus gradually wins queens, drags Martin's king to the centre with e5+, c4+, e3+ and mates with Qf3#.
rules: White (Magnus): standard army. Black (Martin): standard back rank with all 8 pawns replaced by queens.
Normal chess rules; both sides are bots.
